p001.title: Beast of a phone
p001.text: The titanium build feels premium and the camera is stunning in low light.

p001.title: Worth the upgrade
p001.text: Coming from iPhone 12, the difference is huge. Battery could be better.

p001.title: Best iPhone yet
p001.text: Fast, smooth, and the Action button is surprisingly useful.

p002.title: Silence at its best
p002.text: Best noise cancellation I've used on a flight. Sound is rich.

p002.title: Premium feel
p002.text: Comfortable for long hours and the battery truly lasts 30h.

p003.title: Daily runner's dream
p003.text: Super cushioned and light on the feet.

p010.title: Glowing skin!
p010.text: Visible glow in 2 weeks. Doesn't irritate my sensitive skin.

p010.title: Nice texture
p010.text: Absorbs quickly, no stickiness. Slight citrus smell.
